mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "article" extracts one or more Guardian article URLs. "latest" fetches the newest headlines from the Guardian RSS feed.

url.title: Article URL
url.description: A single The Guardian article URL to extract. Used when mode is "article".

urls.title: Article URLs
urls.description: Multiple article URLs to extract in one run. Used when mode is "article".

section.title: Section (latest mode)
section.description: Guardian section to pull from. Used when mode is "latest".

limit.title: Max headlines (latest mode)
limit.description: Maximum number of headlines to return in "latest" mode.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many article pages to fetch in parallel in "article" mode.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is recommended for production.
